verdict.rationale: Nix delivers per-project toolchains: `nix-shell` and `nix develop` build or download a project's declared dependencies and drop you into a shell with compiler paths and other environment variables set. Flakes live in the current directory, multiple versions of a package can coexist, and community users confirm `nix-shell --run` reliably provides the correct dependencies and lets them run incompatible versions side by side. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a checked-in per-project file (shell.nix/flake.nix) pinning specific runtime versions, automatic switching when entering a project directory, and evidence of how version pinning or lock files work.
